name: Tivit
description: A winged sphinx fortune-teller of the Obscura who is struck by the prophecy and whose shop is later wrecked.

timeline.summary: Tivit is gripped by a prophecy of a kitten hiding the cream, corvidae, gold in the water and halos, as Kamiz and Queza visit.
timeline.quote: "The kitten hiding the cream . . . Corvidae, flitting and pecking . . . Gold in the water . . . Hiding the cream, the kitten!"

timeline.summary: Tivit's shop is set aflame and its balcony collapses; Kamiz rescues Tivit but Queza appears crushed before emerging unharmed.
timeline.quote: Kamiz projected her magic forward, gripping Tivit's thick fur and Queza's long coat

timeline.summary: Kamiz foils a Broker agent's contract on Tivit with a mirror and learns the Riveteers smashed a new halo stained glass.
timeline.quote: The binding magic reflected to the agent and fizzled.

pages_say.description: A winged sphinx fortune-teller of the Obscura who is struck by the prophecy and whose shop is later wrecked.
